title: trigonotis sericea
intro: Trigonotis sericea, commonly known as Chinese bugloss, is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Trigonotis sericea include expectorant, antiussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory ailments. The bioactive constituents of Trigonotis sericea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
